entries.631e3362c319b19f: The 4th Medium-Term Management Plan, with the fiscal year ending February 2028 as its final year, lists as priority issues early return to profitability and securing stable earnings, store strategy, sustainability, human resource development and system reform, building a corporate culture, and development of the organizational foundation. As its management strategy, it states that it aims to realize “integrated group operation” by developing drugstores, pharmacies and food manufacturing centered on the supermarket business, while advancing the integration of management and systems and leveraging the strengths of each company. The group vision is “Aiming to be a 100-year company that is loved by the community and healthy and lively.”

entries.7812b0f742ce6cc3: This business manufactures and sells prepared foods such as sushi and rice dishes, and daily-delivery products such as milk and noodles. It is operated by consolidated subsidiary Sanko Shokuhin Co., Ltd., and the products it manufactures are mainly sold at the company's supermarkets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥2 million, and most of its sales are within the group.

entries.f0c9daba21a05bde: The breakdown of consolidated net sales of ¥105,405 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026, by segment net sales to external customers, is Supermarket Business ¥92,333 million, Drugstore Business ¥13,070 million and Food Manufacturing Business ¥2 million. Food Manufacturing Business has intersegment internal sales of ¥5,308 million, far exceeding its external sales, and mainly handles manufacturing for supermarkets within the group. The number of supermarkets is 62 in total (44 in Yamagata Prefecture and 18 in Miyagi Prefecture), and in February 2026 a business including 6 stores in Akita Prefecture was separated. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
